$description: Primitive palette, modeled on Linear. Never referenced by app code; semantic tokens in color.json point here. Chromatic families are generated in OKLCH from one anchor color each (scripts/lib/color.mjs): every family shares the same lightness ramp, so step N has comparable contrast across hues.

gray.$description: Hand-tuned cool neutral. 50/500/600/850/950/1000 are Linear's own UI grays; the rest fill the ramp on the same hue (OKLCH h≈262).

ramp.$description: OKLCH lightness per step and chroma as a fraction of the family's peak. The anchor lands unchanged on the step with the closest lightness.
